name: research
description: Deep web research with verified citations: decompose a question into briefs, search and fetch pages, quote numbers verbatim, and write a report that must pass a mechanical check. Use when a question needs published evidence, not for one-fact lookups. Always call action=guide first and follow it; it explains every other action.
author: strata

action.description: One of: guide, init, search, fetch, quote, status, write, read, check, finish.

run.description: The run's slug, 2-60 lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. llm-judges.

brief.description: search, fetch: the brief id this serves, e.g. 01.

counter.description: search: true for a search for counter-evidence.

text.description: quote: a short literal phrase from the page, 2 to 6 words.

file.description: write, read, check: briefs/NN.md, handbacks/NN.json or reports/final.md.

content.description: write: the file's content, or one part of it.

part.description: write: this part's number, from 1, when sending a file in parts.

parts.description: write: how many parts the file is sent in; omit for one.

max_searches.description: init: the run's search cap, default 24.

max_fetches.description: init: the run's fetch cap, default 60.

examples.prompt: Research whether LLM judges agree with human raters
